what: Text is split into word chunks and shuffled, and as scroll passes through the range, words turn transparent one by one in that shuffled order (no curve, straight scroll) — a scene where the body of an approaching newspaper page is erased here and there until it becomes blank paper. With dir: in, words turn on from the blank in the shuffled order

options.start · end: Scroll range, default ”top 60%” → ”bottom top” — inside a pinned scene, fit it to the length of the scene it is used in
options.each: Share (segment ratio) in which one word fades out, default .05
options.seed: Shuffle seed (integer), default 7 — same order every time it opens

use: Long body
note: The original fades out SplitText words, shuffled with utils.shuffle, across the 30~70% range of the pinned newspaper scene timeline — the part takes its own range separately

from.where: index.js 1 newspaper scene [data-bs-words] — within the pinned 320%, between 30 and 70% the body words switch off in shuffled order
